# Filtered from a full-boot register trace captured on isp1 (g4 image),
# for the "SDK-init replay" test: only W/T/D/R/w kept (the
# "# regtrace ..." header line and "== ..." phase markers dropped), W lines
# in the TBL_ACCESS_CTRL/STS/WR_DATA/RD_DATA range 0x012000-0x01202c dropped
# (mksdkinit.py own docstring), one synthetic command bracket per verb --
# tag N is odi_switch_sdkinit.h own ODI_SDKINIT_<VERB> enum index N, same
# order tools/regtrace/mksdkinit.py own VERBS_ORDER uses. R (a table run
# closing entry) is kept in its own raw run form, never expanded -- the same
# convention compare.py own bracket mode already uses. kind-w (SoC-window
# write, e.g. the PON-PBO IP enable at 0xb800063c) is kept too, in position
# -- dropping it silently is the bug this fixture regeneration exists to
# catch a regression of. Regenerate with the same filter if the source
# capture ever changes -- do not hand-edit.
